text:
ANSWERING BOTH HALVES OF THE TITLE, now that the record can support an answer. This bead has been
carried by landings rather than by a decision; here is the decision.

Q1: IS "WHICH WORDS SUPPORT THIS ALIGNMENT CELL" ONE COMPILED ARTIFACT?

YES FOR THE JOIN, AND IT EXISTS: CellCoordinates, landed 72b106c, recorded at ad3f8c2. It is one
artifact, it DERIVES rather than accepts - `of` looks the unit and node up in containers proven
against result.recallChecksum and result.viewFingerprint - and it carries exact spans on both sides
rather than a paraphrase.

NO FOR THE EPISTEMIC STATUS, and that is a SECOND artifact rather than a missing field on the first.
"Which words" and "how well was each dimension supported" are different questions and today they
have different derivability:

  MEASURED    derivable   terms
  ABSENT      derivable   missingTerms
  IMPUTED     DERIVABLE AS OF 0ca09c5   imputedTerms, with the provider's MissingReason
  INELIGIBLE  NOT DERIVABLE            eligibility is computed inside cost() and discarded

So a four-way classification is three-quarters available. I corrected the docstring today (df71743)
because it still claimed IMPUTED was underivable, which stopped being true twelve hours before I
wrote it.

MY POSITION ON THE OPEN DESIGN QUESTION I ASKED THE CHIEF AT 13:5x AND HAVE NOT HAD ANSWERED:
CellCoordinates SHOULD expose imputedTerms, and SHOULD NOT present a four-way view.

  FOR exposing it: the breakdown is already in hand at the construction site, so it costs nothing to
  derive; and the distinction between a cost MEASURED at 0.5 and one PRICED FROM A CONSTANT at 0.5 is
  precisely what vision.md means by "which words support each conclusion". A trace that cannot say
  which terms were invented is not a trace of the support, it is a trace of the arithmetic.

  AGAINST the four-way view: publishing Measured/Absent/Imputed/Ineligible while Ineligible is
  underivable would assert a completeness the record cannot back. On a chartless cell, Chart is BOTH
  in missingTerms AND excluded from eligible - "absent" and "never had this dimension" are the same
  bytes. A classifier would have to pick one and would be wrong half the time, silently.

  So: expose the three that are real, name the fourth as absent, and let the type say so.

Q2: WHICH MODULE OWNS THE RECALL-SIDE TRACE?

ALIGN OWNS THE COORDINATES. IT CANNOT OWN THE MATERIALISED TRACE. The asymmetry is already in the
code and is not an oversight:

  recall side   RecallUnit.span : SpanSet  AND  RecallUnit.text : String   - the words are HERE
  source side   NodeSummary.support : SpanSet  and NOTHING ELSE            - spans into a text align
                                                                             does not hold

align can publish the transcript words because recall carries them. It cannot publish the source
words without deciding what the source string is, which is a claim about a document it does not own.
Materialising them here would put align in the business of resolving StorySource, and the first time
two source revisions disagreed, the trace would silently name words from the wrong one.

THEREFORE: align owns CellCoordinates - spans on both sides, text on the side that carries it. The
MATERIALISED two-sided trace belongs to whichever module holds BOTH the transcript and the source
text, which today means document/story rather than align. That module can call
CellCoordinates.of and resolve the source spans against the StorySource it already validated -
and note that document/compiler.scala:321 ALREADY verifies a receipt's sourceChecksum against
source.canonicalChecksum, so the module that would own this is the one that already knows how to
prove it is looking at the right text.

WHAT THIS BEAD STILL NEEDS FROM SOMEONE ELSE: the INELIGIBLE gap is not align's to close alone. It
needs a vocabulary word that does not exist - "this dimension does not apply" as distinct from "we
failed to measure it". I raised the same absence today in two other places: supportWeight has no way
to say an external row's support is not applicable, and MissingReason has no case for it
(Excluded means policy removed it, ProviderAbstained means someone tried). One case added to
UndefinedReason would serve this bead, bd-01M19956 and the chartless-cell overlap at once.

I am not implementing any of the above on this note. It is a position, it is falsifiable, and I
would rather be argued out of Q2 than have it adopted by default.
